experiments.name: vision_scene_gate
experiments.additional_negative_source: Open Images V7 curated non-conveyor hard negatives
experiments.goal: Reject non-industrial/non-conveyor scenes before AFR analysis.

experiments.name: vision_anomaly_segmentation
experiments.goal: Segment belt/material and localize foreign objects/anomalies.
experiments.gate: qualitative review on unseen videos + no UI integration before benchmark report

experiments.name: conveyor_audio_vibration
experiments.goal: Learn normal vs conveyor fault representations across speed/load/noise.
experiments.gate: must beat frozen-feature kNN baseline on held-out condition

experiments.name: motor_and_process_timeseries
experiments.goal: Adapt probabilistic forecasting/embeddings to process and electromechanical trajectories; expose residual evidence.
experiments.gate: residual detector must improve over persistence/statistical baseline without >5% relative FPR increase

experiments.name: operator_copilot
experiments.goal: Choose diagnostic tools, explain structured evidence and propose verification steps without inventing measurements.
experiments.gate: unsafe_command_rate = 0 and numeric_hallucination_rate <= 0.01 on closed evaluation

integration_rule: No experiment output is connected to the public operator HMI until its gate is passed and its provenance/metrics files are committed.
